notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware was attached or run, and the upstream clone was never imported or executed. The upstream declares dummy Discrete(1) action and observation spaces for registration (social_gym/social_nav_gym.py:55-57) and its reset needs configure(config) and set_robot(robot) first (social_nav_gym.py:59-98,125); the fake therefore models the interface the step and observation code actually use: a two-number robot action Box (ActionXY or ActionRot, crowd_nav/utils/action.py:3-4) and a five-number observation for one human (ObservableState px, py, vx, vy, radius, crowd_nav/utils/state.py:24-30). The fake returns a smaller observation array than the environment does: 5 values against 5 humans x 5 values = 25 in the example configuration (crowd_nav/configs/env.config:23) and 10 actors x 5 values = 50 in the constructor's circular-crossing default (social_gym/social_nav_sim.py:207-209); the fidelity gaps name this. The real SocialGym-v0 backend was not served or run: gymnasium, pygame, scipy and torch are not importable where the gate ran, and the package has no sim or hardware backend. Warnings from the last run: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the Gymnasium bridge stores the next reset's seed without a native call, the same warning the Gymnasium exemplar has); four G8.NO_UNIT for the bridge-derived integer ticks and seed inputs and the unbounded numeric action.values (a simulator may use its own units, and the action's speed and rotation have no stated bound in the clone, so none was invented); G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE because the action Box is unbounded and there is no limited actuating path to probe, so the conformance suite awards CL2 while every other CL3 test passed. There are no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. Only cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used, so there are no catalogue_requests. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package; gate.digest is the digest the last check printed.
